I reorder this every month!! It’s a must have in my makeup bag!!

reviews.t: I loved the way it really did erase the bags under ...

claims.text: Many reviewers report the applicator or dispenser stops working after only a few uses, making the product inaccessible.
Several reviewers say the product works well to tighten under-eye bags and reduce puffiness, sometimes for many hours.
Some reviewers report the effect is short-lived, lasting only a couple of hours or less.
A few reviewers mention negative side effects such as caking, tightness, bruising, or dark circles after use.
Some reviewers complain about poor customer service and inability to get a refund.
